ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the potential $2B in Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including Dr. Oz's fact-finding mission
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
